My business: dog grooming.
1) Do you do nail trims only?
2) How long does a groom take?
3) Can I stay with my dog?

Nail trims only?
Yes! They're [PRICE] and take about [TIME]. Book a slot or ask about walk-ins.

How long is a groom?
Usually [X–Y HOURS], depending on size and coat. We'll let you know when they're ready.

Can I stay?
[YES/NO + YOUR REASON].

caption:
How to build a reply bank for customer questions with AI

If you answer the same questions every week, stop typing them from scratch. Build a reply bank once, then copy and paste.

Copy this:

"My business: [WHAT YOU DO]. Customers ask me these a lot: [PASTE 5–10 QUESTIONS]. Write a short, friendly reply to each, under 50 words, in plain words. Put anything I need to fill in as [BRACKETS]."

The brackets matter: instead of guessing your prices or opening hours, the AI leaves a gap for you to fill in once.

Then save everything in one note called "Replies". Every time you answer something twice, add it.
